description: Reusable two-column stat card used by the Partner Dashboard for both Tier-2 (Combined Cash Flow: income vs expenses + net) and Tier-3 (Debt & Savings: debt vs savings-progress + savings bar). Flat glass, subordinate to the headline.

columns.description: Exactly 2 columns: [{ icon, iconTint, label, value, valueColor }]. iconTint is `${semanticToken}1a`.

footer.description: Below-divider content. Either { kind: 'net', label, value, valueColor } or { kind: 'progressBar', label, currentText, targetText, percent, fillColor }.

accessibility.labelCashflow: Total income {in}. Total expenses {out}. Net cash flow {sign} {net}.
accessibility.labelDebtSavings: Total debt {debt}. Savings progress {pct} percent. Saved {current} of {target}.
accessibility.colorIndependent: distinct icons per column + text labels; net carries +/- prefix; goal-met shown by the % label, not color alone
accessibility.touchTargets: if columns deep-link, each column >= 44pt tall
accessibility.reducedMotion: progress-bar grow-in uses animation.fast, instant under reduce-motion
